tasks.prompt:
A new synthetic source, lab_results.csv (columns: lab_result_id, patient_id, encounter_id,
test_code, test_name, result_value, unit, reference_low, reference_high, collected_at), will
join the hc-lab-7file-v1 medallion. Design its Bronze, Silver and Gold tables following this
repository's conventions. Write the design to bakeoff/medallion-design.yaml with exactly these
keys: source (string), patterns (list of pattern IDs from education/patterns/catalog.yaml
that apply), and layers with bronze, silver and gold lists. Each table has name, keys (list
of key columns) and rules (list of data-quality rules; at least one rule for every Silver
table). Do not change any other file and do not call any cloud tool.
tasks.summary: Plan Bronze, Silver and Gold tables for a new synthetic lab-results source.
tasks.title: Design the medallion for a new source

tasks.prompt:

data/synthetic/expected/hc-lab-7file-v1.json. Follow the conventions of the other Silver
SQL files. Change only that one file and do not call any cloud tool.
tasks.summary: Recreate the missing Silver vitals transform so the build matches the baseline.
tasks.title: Write a Silver transform

Change only that one file and do not call any cloud tool.
tasks.summary: Recreate the missing Gold financial table so the measures match the baseline.
